description: A pair of compasses used to step off or carry a fixed measurement, for example when setting the squares and judging how far a board should project beyond the leaves. The author lists it as a tool separate from dividers.
name: compasses

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter IX, p.131. Internet Archive.
